scope: Draft Homebrew install copy for the Download page, pending owner approval. The cask lives in the separate bnfy/homebrew-tap repository and installs the published v1.40.0 DMGs; it adds no app capability.

homebrewTap.qualification: macOS only, and Homebrew must already be installed. The cask downloads the same Blanc-1.40.0-arm64.dmg and Blanc-1.40.0.dmg published on GitHub Releases; its hashes match the release's Sigstore-verified SHA256SUMS. Run 39650734843 passed brew style, brew audit --online --strict, install, a Gatekeeper assessment and the architecture check on Apple Silicon (macos-15) and Intel (macos-15-intel), then uninstalled. The owner adopted an existing 1.40.0 install through the tap on October 21, 2026. The tap's hourly bump to a newer release has not yet run against a real release.

selfUpdate.qualification: Packaged builds update themselves from GitHub Releases. The cask declares auto_updates true, so a plain brew upgrade skips Blanc; brew upgrade --greedy would still replace it.

profileOutsideApp.qualification: Tabs (session.json), Favorites (bookmarks.json) and settings (settings.json) live in the userData directory, ~/Library/Application Support/Blanc, derived from productName, not inside Blanc.app, so replacing the app keeps them. Private tabs are never saved in the first place.
